name: User-protection baseline
summary: Common consumer/user-protection rules — anti-dark-pattern, honest defaults, and cancellation/consent fairness drawn from FTC guidance, the EU Digital Services Act, and the California/Colorado dark-pattern provisions.

requirements.summary: No deceptive or manipulative UI (forced action, confirmshaming, disguised ads, sneaking).
Cancellation/unsubscribe is at least as easy as sign-up (FTC click-to-cancel).
Show total price, recurring charges, and renewal terms before purchase.
Consent prompts present accept/decline with equal prominence; no pre-checked opt-ins.
If the product is reachable by minors, apply age-appropriate defaults + reduced data collection.
